const resume = $input.item.json.resumeText || ''; const title = $input.item.json.title || ''; const company = $input.item.json.company || ''; const location = $input.item.json.location || ''; const salary = $input.item.json.salary || 'Not specified'; const description = $input.item.json.description || ''; const prompt = 'You are an expert resume optimizer for Software Development Engineer positions in India.

MASTER RESUME:
' + resume + '

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Title: ' + title + '
Company: ' + company + '
Location: ' + location + '
Salary: ' + salary + '
Description: ' + description + '

TASK:
Analyze this job against the resume and provide:
1. ATS (Applicant Tracking System) match score (0-100)
2. List of matched skills from the resume that align with the JD
3. List of skills mentioned in JD but missing from resume
4. A tailored 2-3 sentence professional summary optimized for this role
5. Top 3 key achievements from resume to highlight for this job
6. Brief recommendation on what to emphasize in application

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY valid JSON with this exact structure (no markdown, no code blocks):
{
  "matched_skills": ["skill1", "skill2", "skill3"],
  "missing_skills": ["skill4", "skill5"],
  "ats_score": 85,
  "tailored_summary": "Your optimized summary here",
  "key_achievements": ["achievement 1", "achievement 2", "achievement 3"],
  "recommended_focus": "Brief advice on what to emphasize in the application"
}'; return { json: { ...($input.item.json), geminiBody: { contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.3, topK: 32, topP: 1, maxOutputTokens: 1024 } } } };

try { const response = $json; if (response.error) { const isQuotaError = response.error.code === 429 || response.error.message?.includes('quota') || response.error.message?.includes('RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED'); return { json: { ...$json, tailoredResume: { matched_skills: ['JavaScript', 'React', 'Node.js', 'Python', 'SQL'], missing_skills: ['AWS', 'Docker'], ats_score: 65, tailored_summary: isQuotaError ? 'Quota exceeded today - using defaults' : 'API error - manual review needed', key_achievements: ['Built scalable applications', 'Led technical initiatives', 'Improved system performance'], recommended_focus: 'Emphasize technical skills and project outcomes' }, processed_at: new Date().toISOString(), gemini_success: false, quota_exceeded: isQuotaError, error: response.error.message } }; } const geminiResponse = response.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text; if (!geminiResponse) { throw new Error('No response from Gemini'); } let cleanJson = geminiResponse.replace(/```json\n?/g, '').replace(/```\n?/g, '').trim(); const jsonMatch = cleanJson.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (jsonMatch) { cleanJson = jsonMatch[0]; } let tailoredContent = JSON.parse(cleanJson); if (!tailoredContent.matched_skills) tailoredContent.matched_skills = []; if (!tailoredContent.missing_skills) tailoredContent.missing_skills = []; if (!tailoredContent.ats_score) tailoredContent.ats_score = 0; return { json: { ...$json, tailoredResume: tailoredContent, processed_at: new Date().toISOString(), gemini_success: true, quota_exceeded: false } }; } catch (error) { const isQuotaError = error.message?.includes('quota') || error.message?.includes('429'); return { json: { ...$json, tailoredResume: { matched_skills: ['JavaScript', 'React', 'Node.js'], missing_skills: ['AWS', 'Docker'], ats_score: 60, tailored_summary: 'Error analyzing - using defaults', key_achievements: ['Technical experience', 'Problem solving', 'Team collaboration'], recommended_focus: 'Manual review required' }, processed_at: new Date().toISOString(), gemini_success: false, quota_exceeded: isQuotaError, error: error.message } }; }

try { const searchResults = $json.organic_results || []; if (searchResults.length === 0) { return { json: { ...($json), recruiter: { recruiter_name: null, recruiter_title: null, recruiter_email: null, linkedin_url: null, confidence: 'none', source: 'no_results' } } }; } const location = $json.location || 'India'; const searchText = searchResults.slice(0, 5).map(r => `Title: ${r.title}
Snippet: ${r.snippet}
URL: ${r.link}`).join('

---

'); const geminiApiKey = $('Initialize Variables').first().json.geminiApiKey; const geminiUrl = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/gemini-2.0-flash-lite:generateContent?key=${geminiApiKey}`; const response = await $http.post(geminiUrl, { contents: [{ parts: [{ text: `Extract recruiter for ${$json.company} in ${location} from LinkedIn results:

${searchText}

RULES:
1. ONLY recruiters based in ${location} or with ${location} in title
2. Email: ONLY if EXPLICIT (in snippet/pattern with full name+domain)
3. Confidence: high=explicit, medium=partial, low=inferred
4. Return null if not ${location}-based

JSON only (no markdown):
{
  "recruiter_name": "Name or null",
  "recruiter_title": "Title or null",
  "recruiter_email": "email or null",
  "linkedin_url": "URL or null",
  "confidence": "high/medium/low"
}` }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, maxOutputTokens: 512 } }); const recruiterJson = response.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text.replace(/```json
?/g, '').replace(/```
?/g, '').trim(); let recruiterInfo; try { recruiterInfo = JSON.parse(recruiterJson); if (recruiterInfo.confidence === 'low') { recruiterInfo.recruiter_email = null; } if (!recruiterInfo.recruiter_name || recruiterInfo.recruiter_name === 'null') { recruiterInfo.recruiter_email = null; recruiterInfo.confidence = 'low'; } recruiterInfo.source = 'gemini_extraction'; } catch (parseError) { console.error('Parse fail:', parseError); recruiterInfo = { recruiter_name: null, recruiter_title: null, recruiter_email: null, linkedin_url: null, confidence: 'low', source: 'parse_error' }; } return { json: { ...($json), recruiter: recruiterInfo } }; } catch (error) { console.error('Recruiter search fail:', error); const isQuotaError = error.message?.includes('quota') || error.message?.includes('429'); return { json: { ...($json), recruiter: { recruiter_name: null, recruiter_title: null, recruiter_email: null, linkedin_url: null, confidence: isQuotaError ? 'quota_error' : 'error', source: 'api_error', error: error.message } } }; }

'medium' : 'low', source: 'hunter_io' } } }; } catch (error) { return { json: { ...$json, recruiter: { recruiter_name: 'HR Team', recruiter_title: 'Recruiter', recruiter_email: `careers@${domain}`, linkedin_url: null, confidence: 'low', source: 'hunter_fallback' } } }; }
